entities.summary: Joseph Tarife Durero is a Philippine-born clergyman and bishop-elect for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Daru-Kiunga in Papua New Guinea. He was appointed bishop in May 2021 and will succeed Canadian Gilles Côté who vacated the post in November 2020.
